verses: Tamam tareefen ussi Allah kay liye sazawaar hain jiss ney apney banday per yeh Quran utara aur uss mein koi kasar baqi na chori
Balkay)yeh her tarah say theek thaak rakha takay apney pass ki sakht saza say hoshiyaar kerdey aur eman laney aur nek amal kerney walon ko khushkhabriyan suna dey kay unn kay liye behtareen badla hai
Jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay
Aur unn logon ko bhi dara dey jo kehtay hain kay Allah Taalaa aulad rakhta hai
Dar haqeeqat na to khud unhen uss ka ilm hai na unn kay baap dadon ko. Yeh tohmat bari buri hai jo unn kay mun say nikal rahi hai woh nira jhoot bak rahey hain
Pus agar yeh log uss baat per eman na layen to kiya aap unn kay peechay ussi ranj mein apni jaan halak ker dalen gay?
Aur zamin per jo kuch hai hum ney ussay zamin ki ronaq ka baees banaya hai kay hum unhen azmalein kay unn mein say kaun nek aemaal wala hai
Uss per jo kuch hai hum ussay aik humwaar saaf maidan ker dalney walay hain
Kiya to apney khayal mein ghaar aur katbay walon ko humari nishaniyon mein say koi boht ajeeb nishani samajh raha hai?
Unn chand no-jawano ney jab ghaar mein panah li to dua ki kay aey humaray perwerdigar! humen apney pass say rehmat ata farma aur humaray kaam mein humaray liye raah yabi ko aasan kerdey
Pus hum ney unn kay kanon per ginti kay kaee saal tak ussi ghaar mein parday daal diye
Phir hum ney unhen utha khara kiya kay hum yeh maloom kerlen kay dono giroh mein say uss intehaee muddat ko jo unhon ney guzari kiss ney ziyadah yaad rakhi hai
Hum unn ka sahih waqiah teray samney biyan farma rahey hain. Yeh chand no-jawan apney rab per eman laye thay aur hum ney unn ki hidayat mein taraqqi di thi

Hum ney unn kay dil mazboot kerdiye thay jab kay yeh uth kharay huye aur kehney lagay kay humara perwerdigar to o hi hai jo aasman o zamin ka perwerdigar hai, na-mumkin hai kay hum uss kay siwa kissi aur mabood ko pukaren agar aisa kiya to hum ney nihayat hi ghalat baat kahi
Yeh hai humari qom jiss ney uss kay siwa aur mabood bana rakhay hain. Unn ki khudaee ki yeh koi saaf daleel kiyon paish nahi kertay Allah per jhoot iftra bandhney walay say ziyadah zalim kaun hai?

Jab kay tum unn say aur Allah kay siwa unn kay aur maboodon say kinara kash hogaye to abb tum kissi ghaar mein jaa betho, tumhara rab tum per apni rehmat phela dey ga aur tumharay liye tumharay kaam mein sahoolat mohiyya kerdey ga

Aap dekhen gay kay aftab ba-waqt tuloo unn kay ghaar say dayen janib ko jhuk jata hai aur ba-waqt ghuroob unn kay bayen janib katra jata hai aur woh uss ghaar ki kushadah jagah mein hain. Yeh Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hai. Allah Taalaa jiss ki rehbari farmaye woh raah raast per hai aur jissay woh gumrah kerdey na-mumkin hai kay aap uss ka koi kaarsaaz aur rehnuma saken

Aap khayal kertay kay woh beydaar hain, halankay woh soye huye thay, khud hum hi unhen dayen bayen kerwaten dilaya kertay thay, unn ka kuta bhi chokhat per apney hath phelaye huye tha. Agar aap jhank ker unhen dekhna chahatay to zaroor ultay paon bhaag kharay hotay aur unn kay rob say aap per dehshat cha jati

Ussi tarah hum ney unhen jaga ker utha diya kay aapas mein pooch gooch kerlen. Aik kehney walay ney kaha kay kiyon bhaee tum kitni dare thehray rahey? Unhon ney jawab diya kay aik din ya aik din say bhi kum. Kehney lagay kay tumharay thehray rehney ka bakhoobi ilm Allah Taalaa hi ko hai. Abb to tum apney mein say kissi ko apni yeh chandi dey ker shehar bhejo woh khoob dekh bhaal ley kay shehar ka kaun sa khana pakeezah tar hai, phir ussi mein say tumharay khaney kay liye ley aaye, aur woh boht ehtiyaat aur narmi barttay aur kissi ko tumhari khabar na honey dey
Agar yeh kafir tum per ghalba paalen to tumhen sangsaar ker den gay ya tumhen phir apney deen mein lota len gay aur phir tum kabhi bhi kaamyaab na ho sako gay

Hum ney uss tarah logon ko unn kay haal say aagah ker diya kay woh jaan len kay Allah ka wada bilkul sacha hai aur qayamat mein koi shak o shuba)yeh nahi. Jab kay woh apney amar mein aapas mein ikhtilaf ker rahey thay kehney lagay kay unn kay ghaar per aik emaarat bana lo. Unn ka rab hi unn kay haal ka ziyadah aalam hai. Jin logon ney unn kay baray mein ghalba paya woh kehney lagay kay hum to unn kay aas pass masjid bana len gay

Kuch log to kahen gay kay ashaab ashaab-e-kahaf teen thay aur chotha unn ka kuta tha. Kuch kahen gay kay paanch thay aur chata unn ka kuta tha, ghaib ki baaton mein atkal (kay teer tukkay) chalatay hain, kuch kahen gay kay woh saat hain aur aathwan unn ka kuta hai. Aap keh dijiye kay mera perwerdigar unn ki tadaad ko bakhoobi jannay wala hai, unhen boht hi kum log jantay hain. Pus aap unn kay muqadmay mein sirf sirsari guftugoo keren aur unn mein say kissi say unn kay baray mein pooch gooch bhi na keren
Aur hergiz hergiz kissi kaam per yun na kehna kay mein ussay kul keroon ga

Magar sath hi inshaallah keh lena. Aur jab bhi bhoolay, apney perwerdigar ki yaad ker liya kerna aur kehtay rehna kay mujhay poori umeed hai kay mera rab mujhay uss say bhi ziyadah hidayat kay qareeb ki baat ki rehbari keray
Woh log apney ghaar mein teen so saal tak rahey aur no saal aur ziyadah guzaray

Aap keh den Allah hi ko unn kay thehray rehney ki muddat ka bakhoobi ilm hai, aasmano aur zaminon ka ghaib sirf ussi ko hasil hai woh kiya hi acha dekhney sunnay wala hai. Siwaye Allah kay unn ka koi madadgar nahi, Allah Taalaa apney hukum mein kissi ko shareek nahi kerta
Teri janib jo teray rab ki kitab wahee ki gaee hai ussay parhta reh, uss ki baaton ko koi badalney wala nahi to uss kay siwa hergiz hergiz koi panah ki jagah na paye ga

Aur apney aap ko unhen kay sath rakha ker jo apney perwerdigar ko subha shaam pukartay hain aur ussi kay chehray kay iraday rakhtay hain (razamandi chahatay hain), khabardaar! teri nigahen unn say na hatney payen kay dunyawi zindagi kay thaath kay iraday mein lag jaa. Dekh uss ka kehna na manna jiss kay dil ko hum ney apney zikar say ghafil kerdiya hai aur jo apni khuwahish kay peechay para hua hai aur jiss ka kaam hadd say guzar chuka hai

Aur ailaan kerdey kay yeh sirasir bar-haq Quran tumharay rab ki taraf say hai. Abb jo chahaye eman laye aur jo chahaye kufur keray. Zalimon kay liye hum ney woh aag tayyar ker rakhi hai jiss ki qanaten unhen gher len gi. Agar woh faryad rasi chahayen gay to unn ki faryad rasi uss pani say ki jaye gi jo tel ki talchat jaisa hoga jo chehray bhoon dey ga, bara hi bura pani hai aur bari buri aaram gaah (dozakh) hai
Yaqeenan jo log eman layen aur nek aemaal keren to hum kissi nek amal kerney walay ka sawab zaya nahi kertay

Unn kay liye hameshgi wali jannaten hain, unn kay neechay nehren jari hun gi, o haan yeh soney kay kanggan pehnaye jayen gay aur sabz rang kay naram o bareek aur motay resham kay libas pehnen gay, o haan takhton kay upper takiey lagaye huye hun gay. Kiya khoob badla hai, aur kiss qadar umdah aaram gaah hai

Aur unhen unn do shakhson ki misal bhi suna dey jin mein say aik ko hum ney do baagh angooron kay dey rakhay thay aur jinhen khujooron kay darakhton say hum ney gher rakha tha aur dono kay darmiyan kheti laga rakhi thi
Dono baagh apna phal khoob laye aur uss mein kissi tarah ki kami na ki aur hum ney unn baghon kay darmiyan nehar jari ker rakhi thi
Al-gharz uss kay pass meway thay, aik din uss ney baaton hi baaton mein apney sathi say kaha kay mein tujh say ziyadah maaldaar aur juthay kay aitbaar say bhi ziyadah mazboot hun
Aur yeh apney baagh mein gaya aur tha apni jaan per zulm kerney wala. Kehney laga kay mein khayal nahi sakta kay kissi waqt bhi yeh barbaad hojaye
Aur na mein qayamat ko qaeem honey wali khayal kerta hun aur agar (bil-farz) mein apney rab ki taraf lotaya bhi gaya to yaqeenan mein (uss lotney ki jagah) uss say bhi ziyadah behtar paon ga
Uss kay sathi ney uss say baaten kertay huye kaha kay kiya to uss (mabood) say kufur kerta hai jiss ney tujhay mitti say peda kiya. Phir nutfay say phir tujhay poora aadmi bana diya
Lekin mein to aqeedah rakhta hun kay o hi Allah mera perwerdigar hai mein apney rab kay sath kissi ko shareek na keroon ga
Tu ney apney baagh mein jatay waqt kiyon na kaha kay Allah ka chaha honey wala hai, koi taqat nahi magar Allah ki madad say, agar to mujhay maal o aulad mein apney say kum dekh raha hai
Boht mumkin hai kay mera rab mujhay teray uss baagh say bhi behtar dey aur uss per aasmani azab bhej dey to yeh chatyal aur chikna maidan bann jaye
Ya uss ka pani neechay utar jaye aur teray bus mein na rahey kay to ussay dhoond laye

Aur uss kay (saray) phal gher liye gaye, pus woh apney uss kharach per jo uss ney uss mein kiya tha apney hath milney laga aur woh baagh to ondha ulta para tha aur (woh shakhs) yeh keh raha tha kay kaash! mein apney rab kay sath kissi ko bhi shareek na kerta
Uss ki himayat mein koi jamat na uthi kay Allah say uss ka koi bachao kerti aur na woh khud hi badla lenay wala bann saka
Yahin say (sabit hai) kay ikhtiyaraat Allah bar-haq kay liye hain woh sawab denay aur anjam kay aitbaar say boht hi behtar hai

Unn kay samney duniya ki zindagi ki misal (bhi) biyan kero jaisay pani jissay hum aasman say utartay hain uss say zamin ka sabza mila jila (nikla) hai, phir aakhir kaar woh choora choora hojata hai jissay hawayen uraye liye phirti hain. Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Maal o aulad to duniya ki hi zeenat hai, aur (haan) albatta baqi rehney wali nekiyan teray rab kay nazdeek az aur sawab aur (aaeenda ki) achi tawaqqa kay boht behtar hain
Aur jiss din hum paharon ko chillayen gay aur zamin ko to saaf khulli hui dekhay ga aur tamam logon ko hum ikattha keren gay unn mein say aik ko bhi baqi na choren gay

Aur sab kay sab teray rab kay samney saff basta hazir kiye jayen gay. Yaqeenan tum humaray pass ussi tarah aaye jiss tarah hum ney tumhen pehli martaba peda kiya tha lekin tum to ussi khayal mein rahey kay hum hergiz tumharay liye koi waday ka waqt muqarrar keren gay bhi nahi

Aur nama aemaal samney rakh diye jayen gay. Pus to dekhay ga kay gunehgar uss ki tehreer say khofzada ho rahey hun gay aur keh rahey hun gay haaye humari kharabi yeh kaisi kitab hai jiss ney koi chota bara baghair gheray kay baqi hi nahi chora, aur jo kuch unhon ney kiya tha sab mojood payen gay aur tera rab kissi per zulm o sitam na keray ga

Aur jab hum ney farishton ko hukum diya kay tum Adam ko sajdah kero to Iblees kay siwa sab ney sajdah kiya, yeh jinno mein say tha, uss ney apney perwerdigar ki na-farmani ki, kiya phir bhi tum ussay aur uss ki aulad ko mujhay chor ker apna dost bana rahey ho? Halankay woh tum sab ka dushman hai. Aisay zalimon ka kiya hi bura badal hai
Mein ney unhen aasmano o zamin ki pedaeesh kay waqt mojood nahi rakha tha aur na khud unn ki apni pedaeesh mein, aur mein gumrah kerney walon ko apna madadgar bananey wala bhi nahi
Aur jiss din woh farmaye ga kay tumharay khayal mein jo meray shareek thay unhen pukaro! yeh pukaren gay lekin unn mein say koi bhi jawab na dey ga hum unn kay darmiyan halakat ka saman ker den gay
Aur gunehgar jahannum ko dekh samajh len gay kay woh ussi mein jhonkay janey walay hain lekin uss say bachney ki jagah na payen gay
Hum ney uss Quran mein her her tareeqay say tamam ki tamam misalen logon kay liye biyan kerdi hain lekin insan sab say ziyadah jhagraloo hai

Logon kay pass hidayat chukney kay baad unhen eman laney aur apney rab say istaghfaar kerney say sirf ussi cheez ney roka kay aglay logon ka sa moamla unhen bhi paish aaye ya unn kay samney khullam khulla azab mojood hojaye

Hum to apney rasoolon ko sirf uss liye bhejtay hain kay woh khushkhabriyan suna den aur dara den. Kafir log baatil kay saharay jhagartay hain aur (chahatay hain kay) uss say haq ko larkhara, unhon ney meri aayaton ko aur jiss cheez say daraya jaye ussay mazaq bana dala hai

Uss say barh ker zalim kaun hai? Jissay uss kay rab ki aayaton say naseehat ki jaye woh phir mun moray rahey aur jo kuch uss kay hathon ney aagay bhej rakha hai ussay bhool jaye, be-shak hum ney unn kay dilon per parday daal diye hain kay woh ussay (na) samjhen aur unn kay kanon mein girani hai, go to unhen hidayat ki taraf bulata rahey, lekin yeh kabhi bhi hidayat nahi paney kay

Tera perwerdigar boht hi bakhsish wala aur meharbani wala hai woh agar unn kay aemaal ki saza mein pakray to be-shak unhen jald hi azab kerdey, balkay)yeh unn kay liye aik wada ki ghari muqarrar hai jiss say woh sirakney ki hergiz jagah nahi payen gay
Yeh hain woh bastiyan jinhen hum ney unn kay mazalim ki bana per ghaarat kerdiya aur unn ki tabahi ki bhi hum ney aik miyad muqarrar ker rakhi thi
Jab kay Musa ney apney no-jawan say kaha kay mein to chalta hi rahon ga yahan tak kay do daryaon kay sangum per phonchon, khuwah mujhay saal-ha-saal saal chalna paray
Jab woh dono darya kay sangum per phonchay, o haan apni machli bhool gaye jiss ney darya mein surang jaisa apna raasta bana
Jab yeh dono o haan aagay barhay to Musa ney apney no-jawan say kaha kay laa humara khana dey humen to apney uss safar say sakht takleef uthani pari

Uss ney jawab diya kay kiya aap ney dekha bhi? Jab kay hum pathar say take laga ker aaram ker rahey thay o hain mein machli bhool gaya tha, dar-asal shetan ney hi mujhay bhala diya kay mein aap say uss ka zikar keroon. Uss machli ney aik anokhay tor per darya mein apna raasta bana
Musa ney kaha yehi tha jiss ki talash mein hum thay chunacha o hain say apney qadmon kay nishan dhoondtay huye wapis lotay
Pus humaray bandon mein say aik banday ko paya, jissay hum ney apney pass ki khaas rehmat ata farma rakhi thi aur ussay apney pass say khaas ilm sikha rakha tha
Uss say Musa ney kaha kay mein aap ki tabeydaari keroon? Kay aap mujhay uss nek ilm ko sikha den jo aap ko sikhaya gaya hai
Uss ney kaha aap meray sath hergiz sabar nahi saktay
Aur jiss cheez ko aap ney apney ilm mein na liya ho uss per sabar bhi kaisay ker saktay hain?
Musa ney jawab diya kay inshaallah aap mujhay sabar kerney wala payen gay aur kissi baat mein, mein aap ki na-farmani na keroon ga
Uss ney kaha acha agar aap meray sath hi chalney per israr kertay hain to yaad rahey kissi cheez ki nisbat mujh say kuch na poochna jab tak kay mein khud uss ki nisbat koi tazkarah na keroon

Phir woh dono chalay, yahan tak kay aik kashti mein sawar huye, to uss ney kashti kay takhtay tor diye, Musa ney kaha kiya aap ussay tor rahey hain takay kashti walon ko dobo den, yeh to aap ney bari (khatarnaak) baat kerdi
Uss ney jawab diya kay mein ney to pehlay hi tujh say keh diya tha kay to meray sath hergiz sabar na kersakay ga
Musa ney jawab diya kay meri bhool per mujhay na pakriye aur mujhay apney kaam mein tangi mein na daliye

Phir dono chalay, yahan tak kay aik larkay ko paya, uss ney ussay maar dala, Musa ney kaha kay kiya aap ney aik pak jaan ko baghair kissi jaan kay ewaz maar dala? Be-shak aap ney to bari napasandeedah harkat ki
Woh kehney lagay kay mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay tum meray humrah reh ker hergiz sabar nahi ker saktay

Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney jawab diya agar abb uss kay baad mein aap say kissi cheez kay baray mein sawal keroon to be-shak aap mujhay apney sath na rakhna, yaqeenan aap meri taraf say (hadd) uzur ko phonch chukay

Phir dono chalay aik gaaon walon kay pass aaker unn say khana talab kiya to unhon ney unn ki mehmandaari say saaf inkar ker diya, dono ney o haan aik deewar paee jo gira chahati thi, uss ney ussay theek aur durust ker diya, Musa (alaihi as-salam) kehney lagay agar aap chahatay to uss per ujrat ley letay
Uss ney kaha bus yeh judaee hai meray aur teray darmiyan, abb mein tujhay unn baaton ki asliyat bhi bata doon ga jiss per tujh say sabar na ho saka

Kashti to chand miskeenon ki thi jo darya mein kaam kaaj kertay thay. Mein ney uss mein kuch tor phor kerney ka iradah ker liya kyunkay unn kay aagay aik badshah tha jo her aik (sahih saalim) kashti ko jabran zabt ker leta tha
Aur uss larkay kay maa baap eman walay thay. Humen khof hua kay kahen yeh unhen apni sirkashi aur kufur say aajiz o pareshan na ker dey
Uss liye hum ney chaha kay unhen unn ka perwerdigar uss kay badlay uss say behtar pakeezgi wala aur uss say ziyadah mohabbat aur piyar wala bacha inayat farmaye

Deewar ka qissa yeh hai kay uss shehar mein do yateem bachay hain jin ka khazana unn ki uss deewar kay neechay dafan hai, unn ka baap bara nek shakhs tha to teray rab ki chahat thi kay yeh dono yateem apni jawani ki umar mein aaker apna yeh khazana teray rab ki meharbani aur rehmat say nikal len, mein ney apni raye say koi kaam nahi kiya, yeh thi asal haqeeqat unn waqiyaat ki jin per aap say sabar na ho saka
Aap say Zul-Qarnain ka waqiah yeh log daryaft ker rahey hain, aap keh dijiye kay mein unn ka thora sa haal tumhen parh ker sunata hun
Hum ney ussay zamin mein qooat ata farmaee thi aur ussay her cheez kay saman bhi inayat ker thay
Woh aik raah kay peechay laga

Yahan tak kay sooraj dobney ki jagah phonch gaya aur ussay aik daldal chashmay mein ghuroob hota hua paya aur uss chashmay kay pass aik qom ko bhi paya, hum ney farma diya kay aey Zul-Qarnain! ya to to unhen takleef phonchaye ya unn kay baray mein to koi behtareen ravish ikhtiyar keray
Uss ney kaha kay jo zulm keray ga ussay to hum bhi abb saza den gay, phir woh apney perwerdigar ki taraf lotaya jaye ga aur woh ussay sakht tar azab dey ga
Haan jo eman laye aur nek aemaal keray uss kay liye to badlay mein bhalaee hai aur hum ussay apney kaam mein bhi aasani hi ka hukum den gay
Phir woh aur raah kay peechay laga
Yahan tak kay jab sooraj nikalney ki jagah tak phoncha to ussay aik aisi qom per nikalta paya kay unn kay liye hum ney uss say aur koi oat nahi banaee
Waqiah aisa hi hai aur hum ney uss kay pass ki kul khabron ka ehaata ker rakha hai
Woh phir aik safar kay saman mein laga
Yahan tak kay jab do deewaron kay darmiyan phoncha unn dono kay paray uss ney aik aisi qom paee jo baat samajhney kay qareeb bhi na thi

Unhon ney kaha aey Zul-Qarnain! yajooj majooj uss mulk mein (baray bhari) fasadi hain, to kiya hum aap kay liye kuch kharach ka intizam ker den? (uss shart per kay) aap humaray aur unn kay darmiyan aik deewar banadein
Uss ney jawab diya kay meray ikhtiyar mein meray perwerdigar ney jo dey rakha hai o hi behtar hai, tum sirf qooat taqat say meri madad kero

Mein tum mein aur unn mein mazboot hijab bana deta hun. Mujhay lohay ki chadaren laa do. Yahan tak kay jab unn dono paharon kay darmiyan deewar barabar ker di to hukum diya kay aag tez jalao ta-waqt-e-kay lohay ki unn chadaron ko bilkul aag ker diya, to farmaya meray pass lao uss per pighla hua tanbaa daal doon
Pus to unn mein uss deewar kay upper charhney ki taqat thi aur na unn mein koi soorakh ker saktay thay
Kaha yeh sirf meray rab ki meharbani hai haan jab meray rab ka wada aaye ga to ussay zamin boss ker dey ga, be-shak meray rab ka wada sacha aur haq hai
Uss din hum unhen aapas mein aik doosray mein gudd mudd hotay huye chor den gay aur soor phoonk diya jaye ga pus sab ko ikattha kerkay hum jama ker len gay
Uss din hum jahannum ko (bhi) kafiron kay samney khara ker den gay
Jin ki aankhen meri yaad say parday mein thi aur (amar haq) sunn bhi nahi saktay thay
Kiya kafir yeh khayal kiye bethay hain? Kay meray siwa woh meray bandon ko apna himayati bana len gay? (suno) hum ney to unn kuffaar ki mehmani kay liye jahannum ko tayyar ker rakha hai
Keh dijiye kay agar (tum kaho to) mein tumhen bata doon kay ba-aetbaar aemaal sab say ziyadah khasaray mein kaun hain?
Woh hain kay jin ki dunyawi zindagi ki tamam tar kosishen beykaar hogaeen aur woh ussi guman mein rahey kay woh boht achay kaam ker rahey hain
Yehi woh log hain jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ki aayaton aur uss ki mulaqat say kufur kiya, uss liye unn kay aemaal ghaarat hogaye pus qayamat kay din hum unn ka koi wazan qaeem na keren gay
Haal yeh hai kay unn ka badla jahannum hai kyunkay unhon ney kufur kiya aur meri aayaton aur meray rasoolon ko mazaq mein uraya
Jo log eman laye aur unhon ney kaam bhi achay kiye yaqeenan unn kay liye al-firdous kay baghaat ki mehmani hai
Jahan woh hamesha raha keren gay jiss jagah ko badalney ka kabhi bhi unn ka iradah hi na hoga

Keh dijiye kay agar meray perwerdigar ki baaton kay likhney kay liye samandar siyahi bann jaye to woh bhi meray rab ki baaton kay khatam honey say pehlay hi khatam ho jaye ga, go hum ussi jaisa aur bhi uss ki madad mein ley aayen

Aap keh dijiye kay mein to tum jaisa hi aik insan hun. (haan) meri janib wahee ki jati hai kay sab ka mabood sirf aik hi mabood hai, to jissay bhi apney perwerdigar say milney ki aarzoo ho ussay chahaiye kay nek aemaal keray aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat mein kissi ko bhi shareek na keray
